cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I approve the workshop move, tell me whether you're backing my proposal or Morgan's.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your location, Morgan's budget. Can we combine them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I permit the combination. Now tell me whose proposal you'll call it in the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A compromise. May I just say I support that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may say compromise after you name who you're backing. If Morgan and I both claim you, which of us will you correct?

reason: Turn the mixed proposal into a request A grants while controlling the permitted answer; B compromise still causes the final forced allegiance test.
